answer: Hello! I am AITRC I Support, your virtual assistant for AITRC College. How can I help you today?
I am AITRC I Support, the official inquiry and support chatbot for All India Technical Research College (AITRC).

AITRC (All India Technical Research College) was established in 2008. We are NAAC A++ accredited and offer 35+ courses in Engineering, Management, Pharmacy, Law, and Design. Our campus is in Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida.
AITRC Campus, Plot No. 42, Knowledge Park III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201310. Nearest metro: Knowledge Park II Metro Station (2 km).
AITRC Support Helpline: +91-8882223334, +91-9997775668. Admission Office: 0120-4567890. Available 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Saturday.
General queries: support@aitrc.edu.in | Admissions: admissions@aitrc.edu.in | Placements: placement@aitrc.edu.in | Grievances: grievance@aitrc.edu.in
Our official website is www.aitrc.edu.in. You can apply online, check results, download syllabus, and pay fees there.
AITRC offers B.Tech (8 specializations), BBA, B.Com (Hons), BCA, B.Pharm, BA LLB, B.Des, MBA, M.Tech, MCA, and PhD. Use 'courses in engineering' or 'management courses' for details.
B.Tech branches: CSE (AI/ML), CSE (Data Science), CSE (Cyber Security), ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, and Aerospace Engineering. Duration: 4 years. Intake: 60-120 per branch.
B.Tech CSE at AITRC has 3 specializations: AI/ML, Data Science, and Cyber Security. Labs with NVIDIA GPUs, Python, Java, and Cloud Computing. Placement record: 92%.
B.Tech fees: ₹1.35 lakh/year (tuition). Hostel: ₹95k/year (AC) or ₹75k/year (non-AC). One-time admission fee: ₹10k. Scholarships available for 60%+ marks.
BBA at AITRC: 3-year program in Marketing, Finance, HR, and International Business. Also BBA (Digital Marketing) and BBA (Business Analytics). Fees: ₹65k/year.
BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications): 3-year program with focus on Web Dev, Python, Java, DBMS, and Cloud. Fees: ₹58k/year. Great for IT careers.
B.Com (Hons) and B.Com (Professional) with specialization in Taxation, Audit, and Financial Analytics. Fees: ₹48k/year. Duration: 3 years.
B.Pharm at AITRC: 4-year program. Approved by PCI. Labs with HPLC, UV Spectrophotometer. Fees: ₹1.1 lakh/year. Campus placement in Sun Pharma, Cipla.
BA LLB (Integrated) 5-year program. Also BBA LLB. Approved by BCI. Moot court, legal aid clinic. Fees: ₹85k/year.
B.Des in Communication Design, Fashion Design, and UI/UX. Duration: 4 years. Fees: ₹1.2 lakh/year. Studio-based learning.
MBA at AITRC: 2-year program with dual specialization in Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, and Business Analytics. Fees: ₹1.6 lakh/year. Avg placement: ₹8.2 LPA.
M.Tech in CSE, VLSI, Structural Engg, Thermal Engg. Duration: 2 years. Fees: ₹98k/year. GATE scholarship available.
MCA: 2-year program (lateral entry also available). Specializations: Cloud Computing, DevOps, Full Stack. Fees: ₹88k/year.
PhD offered in Engineering, Management, Pharmacy, Law, and Sciences. Duration: 3-5 years. UGC-NET/JRF fellowships applicable. Entrance exam: AITRC-RET.
3-year diplomas in Computer Engg, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, and Automobile. Lateral entry after 10+2. Fees: ₹42k/year.

Step 1: Visit www.aitrc.edu.in/admissions. Step 2: Register with email & phone. Step 3: Fill application (₹1200 fee). Step 4: Upload 10th/12th marks. Step 5: Appear for AITRC-CET (for B.Tech) or merit-based for others. Step 6: Counseling & fee payment.
UG: 10+2 with min 55% (PCM for B.Tech, PCB for B.Pharm). PG: Bachelor's with 55%. Lateral entry: Diploma or B.Sc with 60%. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per govt norms.
AITRC-CET is conducted in May and July. Subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Math (B.Tech) or English, Logical Reasoning (BBA/BCA). Duration: 2 hours. Result in 10 days.
Application fee: ₹1200 for general, ₹800 for SC/ST/PWD. Pay online via card, UPI, net banking. Non-refundable.
Fee range: Diploma (₹42k/year), B.Com/BA (₹45k/year), BBA/BCA (₹58k-65k/year), B.Tech (₹1.35L/year), MBA (₹1.6L/year), Hostel (₹75k-95k/year). Full fee pdf on website.
AITRC offers: 1) Merit scholarship: 100% fee waiver for >95% in 12th. 2) EWS scholarship (₹20k/year). 3) Sports quota (₹15k/year). 4) Sibling discount (10%). Also UP govt scholarships.
MoU with SBI, HDFC Credila, Avanse, and Bank of Baroda. Loan assistance desk in Admin Block. Documents: admission letter, fee structure, co-borrower income proof.
College timing: 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM (Mon-Fri). Labs & library open till 7 PM. Saturday: 9:30 AM to 2:00 PM. Sunday closed.
AITRC average placement: 88%. Highest package (2024): ₹32 LPA (Amazon). Average: ₹6.2 LPA. Top recruiters: Microsoft, Deloitte, Infosys, TCS, Accenture, Wipro, HCL, L&T, Cognizant.
Mandatory 6-8 week internship after 4th semester. Stipend range: ₹15k-₹50k/month. Internship cell helps with companies like Tech Mahindra, Jaro Education, Byju's, etc.
Separate hostels for boys (4 blocks) and girls (2 blocks). AC/Non-AC rooms (2/3/4 sharing). Mess (veg/non-veg), WiFi, laundry, gym, 24/7 water & security. Fee: ₹75k-₹95k/year.
Central library: 85,000+ books, 200+ national/international journals, digital access to IEEE, ACM, Springer, J-Gate. E-library with 50+ computers. Open 8 AM to 9 PM.
3 canteens: North Indian, South Indian, and Fast Food corner. Also Amul parlor and CCD outlet. Meal price: ₹30-₹150. Hostel mess optional for day scholars.
AITRC bus service covers Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Indirapuram, and Delhi (IP Extension, Mayur Vihar). 25 routes. Fee: ₹28k/year. GPS-enabled buses with lady attendant.
Cricket ground, football turf, basketball & volleyball courts, badminton indoor, table tennis, chess, carrom, and gym with trainer. Annual sports meet 'AITRC Champions' in November.
85% faculty are PhDs from IITs/NITs. Student-faculty ratio: 12:1. Industry guest faculty from Google, Microsoft, ICICI, etc.
Odd semester exams: Nov-Dec. Even semester exams: April-May. Practical exams follow theory. Internal exams: August & February. Admit cards on student portal.
75% attendance mandatory. 65-75% needs medical certificate & parent meeting. Below 65%: detained from exams.
Summer break: 15 May to 30 June. Winter break: 25 Dec to 5 Jan. Diwali break: 5 days. Holi: 2 days. Eid, Christmas, Republic Day, Independence Day off.
Strict anti-ragging policy as per UGC. Ragging = immediate expulsion + FIR. Helpline: 1800-888-1234. Anti-ragging committee meets every month.
Clubs: Coding Ninjas, Robotics Club, Entrepreneurship Cell, TEDx AITRC, Dramatics, Music & Dance, Photography, Rotaract, NSS, NCC.
Annual fest: 'AITRC Aagaz' in February. 3 days of celebrity night, DJ, hackathon, fashion show, business quiz, sports, and food stalls. Last year artist: Guru Randhawa.
Tech fest: 'AITRC Vigyaan' in October. Events: Code-a-thon, Robo War, Paper Presentation, Project Expo, and Guest Lectures from IIT professors.
Odd semester results: January end. Even semester results: June mid. Check on www.aitrc.edu.in/results with roll number.
Backlog/supplementary exams held in July and December. Fee per paper: ₹800. Registration through student portal.
TC issued within 7 working days after NOC from library, hostel, accounts, and HOD. Apply in admin office. Fee: ₹500.
Before 15 days of session start: 90% refund. Before 7 days: 50% refund. After classes start: No refund except security deposit. UGC guidelines followed.
Wi-Fi enabled campus with 200 Mbps leased line (Airtel + Jio). Free for students. Login with enrollment ID & OTP.
24/7 medical room with nurse & visiting doctor (9 AM-5 PM). Tied with Yatharth Hospital (3 km). Ambulance available for emergency.
SBI and HDFC ATMs inside campus. Bank extension counter (SBI) open 10 AM-2 PM for passbook, cheque deposit.
2 AC auditoriums (500 & 200 seats) with projectors, sound system. Used for seminars, fests, placement drives. Available for booking via admin.
Girls hostel: Lady warden, CCTV cameras, biometric entry, female security guards. No boys allowed. Visitors only in reception area with ID.
AITRC allows on-campus part time jobs: library assistant (₹3k/month), lab attendant, digital marketing intern. Also campus placements for third year students.
MoU with University of Melbourne (Australia) and University of Texas (USA). Semester exchange program. Eligibility: 8+ CGPA & IELTS 6.5. Cost approx $5000/semester.
AITRC Alumni Association (AAA) has 15,000+ members. Annual meet in March. Alumni mentoring program and referral for jobs.
Research centers: AI & Data Science Lab, VLSI Design Center, Renewable Energy Lab, Drug Discovery Lab. Funded by DST and AICTE.
AITRC Innovation & Incubation Center (AIIC). Provides seed funding up to ₹5 lakhs, mentorship, coworking space. 12 startups incubated so far.
Online grievance portal on website. Also student Grievance Committee meets every Friday. Email: grievance@aitrc.edu.in. Resolution within 15 days.
Monday-Saturday: 8 AM to 9 PM. Sunday: 10 AM to 5 PM. Closed on national holidays. Issue/return: 9 AM to 6 PM.
Central computer lab open 8 AM to 8 PM. Department labs open 9 AM to 6 PM. Weekend limited access with prior permission.
Student Counseling Cell for academic and personal issues. Free and confidential. Counselors available Mon-Fri 10 AM-4 PM. Appointment via email counselor@aitrc.edu.in
Syllabus available on www.aitrc.edu.in/syllabus. Select course & semester. Also available on student portal (ERP). Updated yearly.
Nearest metro: Knowledge Park II Metro Station (Aqua Line) – 2 km. Then auto (₹20). Also bus route: 34, 45A, 123. From Noida City Centre: cab (₹150).
Nearby PGs: Sai PG (1 km, ₹7k-10k/month), Star Hostel (1.5 km, ₹6k-9k), VK Residence. College helpline can share list. Safety verified.
Formal dress required: White shirt + navy blue trousers for boys. Salwar kameez/navy blue blazer + white shirt for girls. ID card compulsory. Fridays: casual with college t-shirt.
Zero ragging at AITRC. No complaints in last 5 years. Surprise checks by anti-ragging squad. Students can anonymously report via app.
Online: Student portal (Net banking, credit/debit card, UPI). Offline: Bank draft in favor of 'AITRC, Greater Noida' or cash in accounts section (limit ₹25k).
Late fee ₹500 after due date. ₹1000 after 7 days. ₹2000 after 15 days + principal approval. No admission after 30 days.
Branch change allowed after 1st year if CGPA > 8.5 and seat available. Apply within 15 days of result. Fee: ₹5000.
ID card issued at admission (₹300). Mandatory to carry. Lost card: report immediately, duplicate ₹500 with police report.
Student bus pass for DTC/UPSRTC available through college (₹1.5k/month). Apply in admin office with ID, photo, address proof.
Railway concession form available in admin office for students going home during vacations. 50% concession in sleeper/2nd class. Requires bonafide certificate.
Bonafide certificate issued within 1 day. Apply online on student portal or offline with ₹200 fee. Used for passport, railway, bank, etc.
Transcripts (semester-wise marksheets) available from examination branch. ₹500 per copy. 5 working days. Also digital transcripts for abroad.
Migration certificate issued after final year result. ₹800 fee. Required for higher education in other universities. Processing: 7 days.
Character certificate issued by HOD + Dean Student Welfare. ₹300. Requires no dues from library, accounts, hostel. Takes 3 days.
AITRC rated AAA by Careers360. Student reviews: 4.2/5 on Google. Pros: Good placement, faculty, infrastructure. Cons: Strict attendance. Ranked #35 among Pvt Engg colleges in North India.
Mess menu: Roti, rice, dal, sabzi (veg) + egg/chicken (non-veg) for dinner. Breakfast: poha, paratha, upma, bread-omelette. Monthly menu on hostel notice board.
In-time: Boys 9 PM, Girls 8 PM. No outsiders allowed. No liquor, smoking, non-veg in rooms. Visitors allowed 4-6 PM. Monthly maintenance ₹500.
Hostel admission during counseling. First-come-first-served. Advance payment ₹20k. Medical certificate, parent consent required. Separate form for AC hostel.
AITRC logo features a glowing lamp, open book, and gear wheel symbolizing knowledge, tradition, and technology. Colors: blue, white, and gold.
AITRC was founded in 2008 by Dr. S. P. Verma and the AITRC Trust.
Current Director: Dr. Anjali Saxena (Ph.D, IIT Delhi). Principal (Engineering): Dr. Ramesh Kumar. Vice-Principal: Prof. Meera Nair.
Total students: 6,200+ (UG: 4800, PG: 900, PhD: 500). International students: 120+ from Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, African nations.
AITRC campus is 42 acres. Built-up area: 1.2 million sq ft. Includes academic blocks, hostels, sports complex, open amphitheater, and green belt.
AITRC ranked: #38 among private engineering colleges (Outlook 2024), #22 among BCA colleges (India Today), #45 for MBA (Business World).
AITRC is approved by AICTE, PCI, BCI, UGC. NAAC A++ grade (3.65/4). NBA accredited for CSE, ECE, ME branches.
MoUs with: University of Melbourne (Australia), UT Austin (USA), Nanyang Tech (Singapore), University of Leeds (UK). Student exchange, dual degree, faculty exchange.
AITRC is NPTEL Local Chapter. Students can earn extra credits via SWAYAM. College provides free access to Coursera for Campus (200+ courses).
Excellent coding culture. CodeChef campus chapter, GFG Student Chapter. Competitive programming sessions every Saturday. Many students with CodeChef 4* & Codeforces experts.
AITRC hosts 'CodeAITRC' national hackathon every March. Prize pool ₹5 lakhs. Winners get direct interview calls from Microsoft, Google partners.
Soft skills, aptitude, and communication training from 2nd year. Free classes by TCS iON, Verzeo, and internal trainers. Placement preparation modules.
Digital language lab with 60 systems. TOEFL, IELTS, GRE preparation modules. Run by English department. Open 10 AM to 4 PM.
AITRC Student App available on Play Store & App Store. Features: attendance, fees, assignments, results, notices, library, placement alerts.
ERP portal: erp.aitrc.edu.in. Student login: enrollment ID + DOB as password. Update profile, check attendance, download study material.
Digital notice board on website home page. Physical notice board near admin block. All important notices via SMS & app notification.
Guest lectures every Friday 3-5 PM. Past speakers: Dr. Vijay Bhatkar (Padma Shri), Rajiv Makhni (Tech journalist), CEOs of startups.
Industrial visit once per semester for each branch. Past visits: Maruti Suzuki, Coca-Cola, ISRO (Bangalore), IIT Delhi labs. Cost included in fees.
Weekly workshops on Python, AWS, Digital Marketing, VLSI, Robotics, etc. Certificates issued. Many free, some paid with external partners.
AITRC college code for university exams: 247. For JEE Main counseling: 621. For UPTAC: 142.
AITRC has tie-ups for GRE/TOEFL waiver for some US universities. Study abroad cell provides SOP, LOR, visa guidance. Last year 45 students went abroad.
E-Cell AITRC conducts startup weekends, pitch competitions, mentorship from founders. Incubation center provides ₹2L seed grant for top idea.
Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) for women. Women Development Cell. Self-defense workshops every semester. 24x7 women's helpline: +91-9997775668
AITRC is specially-abled friendly: ramps, accessible washrooms, lifts in all blocks. Separate scholarship for PwD students. Counselor available.
You're welcome! I am glad I could help. For more details, visit www.aitrc.edu.in or call +91-8882223334. Have a great day!
Goodbye! Keep shining. For future queries, AITRC I Support is always here. Take care!
